---
title: "Problems and suggestions"
---

If you find an error in the data (a speech attributed to the wrong person, a
wrong party or office, an OCR error that affects a search) or in the package,
or if you would like a new feature, please open an issue at:

<https://github.com/hunsao/parlcat2Rep/issues>

When reporting a data error, please include the session (`sessio`) and the
position of the speech (`ordre`), and, if possible, the page of the PDF
(`pagina`).

The full record of the doubtful cases already reviewed, with the decision
taken for each, is available with `parl_review_cases()`.
